name: Body Temperature
description: Cold Sweat's temperature for your body, shown on the HUD.

pages.title: Body Temperature
pages.text:
**Body temperature** comes from Cold Sweat and has its own icon on the HUD. It drifts toward the **world temperature**: how hot or cold the spot you stand in is.\
\
Too far either way and you take damage and cannot sleep. Insulated armor slows the drift; a fire, burner or Hearth warms you.
